title: Temporary roof tarp leak sequence
summary: Controls roof leaks while avoiding dangerous climbing during storms.
content: Temporary roof tarp leak sequence is a practical offline routine for roof leak control. During wind, lightning, or unstable roof conditions, manage water from inside instead of climbing. Move people, beds, medicines, batteries, documents, and dry food away from drip zones. Catch water and mark it as non-drinking unless assessed. Place external tarp only when weather, ladder, roof, and helper conditions are safe. Check ceiling sagging, cracks, electrical smell, mold, and slip hazards every shift.
